images.alt: Photo of three people and a dog walking along a beach at low tide. The people are viewed from behind, walking barefoot near the water’s edge, with reflections visible on the wet sand. A headland can be seen in the distance, and the scene is lit by soft evening or early morning light. At the bottom of the image are the New Zealand Government | Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa logo and the Ministry of Health | Manatū Hauora logo.

post.text:
The Mental Health and Wellbeing Strategy 2026-2036 has been launched. Providing a 10-year direction for improving mental health, addiction, and wellbeing outcomes in Aotearoa New Zealand. Shaped by feedback from around 900 people and organisations.
